name: DEWALT DALE downward drilling robot
specialisedFor: downward drilling of anchor holes in concrete floor slabs
summary: A wheeled autonomous robot that drills holes down into concrete floor slabs at points taken from a CAD/CSV file, for example for server rack stops and MEP supports in data centres; several robots can work as a fleet.

germany.statusNote: No DALE page found on dewalt.de; DEWALT's US page offers leasing through its representatives. Co-developer August Robotics has an office in Düsseldorf, a German DALE page with a contact form, and says the robots are deployed on hyperscale sites in the US and Europe. No public price; confirm that orders from German contractors are accepted.

sellers.name: August Robotics
sellers.note: Co-developer of DALE. Office at Oberbilker Allee 270A, 40227 Düsseldorf (About page). Sells with training and support (in-person training, online videos, 24/5 technical support) and offers an August Robotics operator on site.

specs.label: Time per small hole
specs.conditions: 3/4 in. x 2 in. hole; DEWALT says 10x faster than manual drilling for this hole size, without rebar

specs.label: Drill
specs.value: DEWALT SDS Max rotary hammer; rebar mode with SDS Max carbide bits; detects certified DEWALT bits

specs.label: Obstacles it avoids
specs.conditions: avoids objects taller than 3 in.; also detects cliffs and drops

specs.label: Software
specs.value: Windows tablet app; drilling points uploaded as CAD/CSV; layout points from CAD models including MSuite

specs.label: Dust extraction
specs.conditions: integrated automatic dust monitoring and vacuum extraction

notes: Drills downward only, into concrete floors; not for ceilings or walls.
A DEWALT drilling rig on the August Robotics mobile base (AMR); the product carries both logos (The Robot Report).
Works autonomously from a CAD/CSV list of drilling points; several robots share the work as a fleet; remote monitoring.
Avoids objects taller than 3 in. and detects drops; cameras check hole quality and dust around the holes.
No source gives weight, size, runtime per battery or stair/slope ability.

images.alt: Three DEWALT DALE drilling robots on a concrete floor in a large hall (official image, appears to be a 3D render)

evidence.task: Shown drilling at the World of Concrete trade show
evidence.where: World of Concrete, Las Vegas, USA

evidence.task: Drilled floor holes for server rack stops and MEP supports in a year-long pilot: more than 230,000 holes at 99.97% accuracy over 26 data center construction phases
evidence.where: Unnamed hyperscaler (large technology company), data center projects; countries not named
evidence.note: In January 2026 DEWALT reported 90,000+ holes over 10 phases; The Robot Report quoted 12 robots in the early access program.

evidence.task: Deployed on hyperscale construction sites in the US and Europe
evidence.where: US and Europe (customers and sites not named)
evidence.note: Statement by August Robotics in its Series B announcement; no European customer named.
